notes: Two earlier attempts logged: KeyError from the QPP helper's short-dict early-return branch, and a harness bug that overwrote the instruction-only n_tokens so even `control` differed from the published frame (AUC 0.8238 vs 0.8233). After the fix control reproduces the published dev AUC EXACTLY (0.8233/0.8294/0.7951) with 0 label drift. RESULT: adding confusable siblings raises failure monotonically (distract_8: +0.181/+0.224/+0.101) and the frozen predictor's mean risk rises by +0.181/+0.224/+0.101 - 1:1 tracking; curated enrichment of the GOLD description drives prevalence 0.0777->0.0012 / 0.1292->0.0022 / 0.0424->0.0010, while the SAME edit on a random NON-gold tool makes routing WORSE (0.0777->0.1083 etc.), so the specificity control passes; namespace renaming and order shuffling are near-no-ops. AUC under enrichment is NOT model improvement - prevalence ~0.001 makes AUROC degenerate, and the artifact is labelled as such.
